fact: The General Information Authority says the Digital Identity Management System for Citizens, including Level 3 biometric identity in technical trials with the Central Bank and banks, is part of implementing the National Digital Transformation Strategy; no target or report is cited.

The General Information Authority announced on 19 November 2025 the pilot phases of the second level of the LY-DNID digital identity system as part of implementing the National Digital Transformation Strategy 2023-2030, citing the first level's adoption in a number of institutions and measuring it against no strategy target.

The paper says the National Committee for Digital Transformation, established in 2022, marked a renewed effort to develop a comprehensive digital strategy, emphasising regulatory reform, capacity building, infrastructure and citizen participation, with a target for implementation by 2030, citing the General Information Authority (2022).

Prime Minister Abdul Hamid Dabaiba of the Government of National Unity approved the national strategy for government digital transformation, prepared by the Supreme Committee for Digital Transformation, at the Libyan Economic Forum on Monday 21 April 2025, per the General Information Authority (dateline 22 April).
